newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago NBD unit offers certificates.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago NBD unit offers certificates.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp said its FCC National Bank subsidiary made a $1.1 billion public offering of two series of floating rate Class A certificates backed by credit card receivables.
Both series represent an undivided interest in the assets of First Chicago Master Trust II and mark the 18th and 19th offerings from this Master Trust.
The $400 million Series R certificates are priced at par and bear interest at a rate equal to seven basis points more than the one-month London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR).
The $700 million Series S certificates are priced at par and bear interest at a rate equal to 12.5 basis more than one- month LIBOR.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
